link.088977681e2f.source: Xu et al., ReWOO: Decoupling Reasoning from Observations (2023). The planner / worker / solver decomposition this module's Workflow Agent implements.
link.088977681e2f.value: Xu et al., ReWOO: Decoupling Reasoning from Observations (2023)。本模組的工作流程代理程式採用了 planner / worker / solver 分解方式。

link.139eba09e8b7.source:
At each step the model reads the latest observation before it picks an action and runs a tool, then sizes up whatever came back and chooses again. The agent reacts to whatever the previous tool call returned, so the path through the tools takes shape as it runs. That makes ReAct strong when the path depends on intermediate results and weak when many steps could have run at once.

Paper: Yao et al., 2022.
link.139eba09e8b7.value:
在每一步中，模型都會先讀取最新觀察結果，再選擇行動並執行工具；隨後評估傳回結果，再次作出選擇。代理程式會對上一次工具呼叫的傳回結果作出回應，因此工具使用路徑是在執行過程中逐步形成的。當執行路徑取決於中間結果時，ReAct 表現出色；而當多個步驟本可同時執行時，它的表現則較弱。

論文：Yao et al., 2022。

link.1be52ce4d6ee.source: Comprehensive list at Going Further · References.
link.1be52ce4d6ee.value: 完整列表請參閱深入探索 · 參考資料。

link.3358ef3956ff.source: Madaan et al., Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback (2023). The pattern behind iterative multi-pass research: an agent critiques its own output and re-runs until a quality threshold is met.
link.3358ef3956ff.value: Madaan et al., Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback (2023)。迭代式多輪研究背後的模式：代理程式評判自己的輸出並重新執行，直到達到品質閾值。

link.39f1ebc65c2a.source:
The model writes the full plan upfront in one LLM call before any tool runs at all. A deterministic executor then runs every tool that the plan named, often in parallel, and a second LLM call reads what came back to synthesize the results. Because the plan never sees a tool result, the model "reasons without observation." That makes ReWOO strong when the steps are independent and weak when later steps need to react to earlier ones.

Paper: Xu et al., 2023.
link.39f1ebc65c2a.value:
在任何工具開始執行之前，模型會透過一次 LLM 呼叫預先寫出完整規劃。隨後，確定性執行器通常會並行執行規劃中指定的所有工具，再由第二次 LLM 呼叫讀取傳回結果並進行綜合。由於規劃始終看不到工具結果，模型是在“無觀察的情況下推理”。因此，當各步驟彼此獨立時，ReWOO 表現出色；而當後續步驟需要根據前序結果作出回應時，它的表現則較弱。

論文：Xu et al., 2023。

link.4f07e539a6af.source: Wang et al., Plan-and-Solve Prompting (2023). The simpler ancestor: a single LLM call writes a plan, the same LLM executes step-by-step. ReWOO splits planner from executor.
link.4f07e539a6af.value: Wang et al., Plan-and-Solve Prompting (2023)。這是更簡單的前身：一次 LLM 呼叫寫出規劃，同一個 LLM 逐步執行規劃。ReWOO 將 planner 與執行器分離。

rich.5ed16cafc93d.source: Compare the added calls and coordination with the work they enable. Different prompts or tools can help specialists focus; independent work can overlap. Measure the resulting latency and answer quality before deciding whether to split the task. Failure isolation also needs explicit handling: the examples below use Promise.all, which rejects if any branch rejects.
rich.5ed16cafc93d.value: 比較新增的呼叫與協調成本，以及它們能完成的工作。不同的提示詞或工具可協助專家聚焦；獨立工作可同時進行。決定是否拆分任務前，先測量延遲與回答品質。故障隔離也需要明確處理：以下範例使用 Promise.all，只要任一分支的 Promise 遭拒，整體 Promise 就會遭拒。

rich.82b2c51d66a4.source: Promise.all is JavaScript's helper for starting several promises and waiting until all of them finish. Here it is just the concurrency mechanism: it does not call the model and it does not decide which searches to run.
rich.82b2c51d66a4.value: Promise.all 是 JavaScript 中用於啟動多個 promise 並等待它們全部完成的輔助函式。在這裡，它只負責實現併發：既不呼叫模型，也不決定要執行哪些搜尋。

rich.8b10c8770bc6.source: The next two parts carry this composition idea forward. Part B (Indices) points the same idea at corpora rather than at other agents so that a knowledge layer becomes an agent wrapping a body of data behind a query interface. Part C (Deep Agents) takes it further still, into a planner agent that dispatches sub-agents in fresh contexts and persists their working state to a virtual filesystem.
rich.8b10c8770bc6.value: 接下來的兩個部分將繼續拓展這一組合思路。B 部分（索引）將同樣的思路用於語料庫，而非其他代理程式，使知識層成為一個代理程式，透過查詢介面封裝一組資料。C 部分（深度代理程式）會進一步建置一個 planner 代理程式，由它在全新上下文中排程子代理程式，並將其工作狀態持久化到虛擬檔案系統。

rich.8b46273b0a2f.source: Synthesizer. A second LLM call reads every result and writes the brief, citing each search by index.
rich.8b46273b0a2f.value: 綜合器。第二次 LLM 呼叫讀取所有結果並撰寫簡報，同時按索引引用每項搜尋。

rich.90cf8f19cd7a.source: The overhead tax in concrete terms. Every agent boundary adds model-call latency and routing logic. It also creates another source of malformed messages and replaces a readable timeline with a trajectory that fans across workers.
rich.90cf8f19cd7a.value: 開銷具體體現在哪裡。每個代理程式邊界都會增加模型呼叫延遲和路由邏輯，還會引入一個新的訊息格式錯誤來源，並將清晰易讀的時間線變成一條向多個工作單元分叉的執行軌跡。

rich.d728bd0d5ae9.source: Executor. Plain JavaScript. Every query runs concurrently via Promise.all, with no LLM calls at this stage.
rich.d728bd0d5ae9.value: 執行器。使用純 JavaScript。每個查詢都透過 Promise.all 併發執行，此階段不進行 LLM 呼叫。

rich.dfb993bf67b0.source: System prompt. The behaviour contract: what it does, what it refuses, and how it phrases its replies.
rich.dfb993bf67b0.value: 系統提示詞。行為約定：它要做什麼、拒絕做什麼，以及如何組織回覆。

rich.e3bb4592aaee.source: Compare one support incident. For “I was charged twice for the same subscription,” a single ReAct loop reads each lookup result before choosing its next action. A structured workflow can route billing verification and account-history checks into independent branches, then combine their evidence. Use the loop when the next step depends on the latest observation. Use the workflow when the branches and their join are known before execution.
rich.e3bb4592aaee.value: 對比同一個支援事件的處理方式。對於“同一訂閱被重複扣費”這一問題，單個 ReAct 迴圈會先讀取每次查詢的結果，再選擇下一步操作。結構化工作流程可以將賬單核驗和賬戶歷史記錄檢查路由到相互獨立的分支，然後彙總各分支的證據。如果下一步取決於最新的觀察結果，請使用迴圈。如果在執行前就已明確各個分支及其匯合方式，請使用工作流程。

rich.e622373c2f66.source: Routing is a different shape of multi-agent in which a triage agent classifies the input and hands it to one specialist. Because the classifier must emit one of a fixed enum of categories, the output needs a tight contract. A fixed enum is a closed list of allowed labels; if the model returns anything else, the router should reject the route or retry under stricter instructions instead of guessing. Each specialist downstream owns a narrow system prompt and does not need to see the triage agent's reasoning.
rich.e622373c2f66.value: 路由是多代理程式的另一種組織方式：分流代理程式對輸入進行分類，再將其交給一個專用代理程式。由於分類器必須輸出固定列舉中的一個類別，因此輸出需要遵循嚴格的約定。固定列舉是一個封閉的允許標籤列表；如果模型傳回其他任何值，路由都應拒絕該結果或在更嚴格的指令下重試，而不能自行猜測。下游每個專用代理程式都有範圍明確的系統提示詞，無需檢視分流代理程式的推理過程。

rich.ee9574e0b7d0.source: Planner. One schema-bound LLM call emits a JSON list of 3-5 search queries.
rich.ee9574e0b7d0.value: Planner。一次受 schema 約束的 LLM 呼叫會生成包含 3 至 5 個搜尋查詢的 JSON 列表。

rich.f27440ffd362.source: A single ReAct loop handles most one-shot tasks, but harder problems sometimes need structure that decides work before the next tool result arrives. A workflow agent means an agent system where your harness controls a workflow: a graph of model calls, deterministic code steps, tool calls, and specialist loops. This shape helps when sub-tasks that run in parallel can share results, when a plan can be written before tools run, or when routing should follow a rule instead of the last observation.
rich.f27440ffd362.value: 單個 ReAct 迴圈可以處理大多數一次性任務，但更困難的問題有時需要一種結構，在下一個工具結果傳回之前就決定要執行的工作。工作流程代理程式是指由執行框架控制工作流程的代理程式系統：該工作流程由模型呼叫、確定性程式碼步驟、工具呼叫和專家迴圈組成。以下情形適合採用這種結構：並行執行的子任務可以共享結果；可以在工具執行前制定規劃；或者路由應遵循規則，而不是取決於最近一次觀察結果。

text.5ff0f3bacd3b.source:

      a specialist loop, or a group of parallel branches. At each boundary, it decides
      what context crosses, what can branch, and which results feed the next pipeline
      stage. Fan-out and fixed routing make that control visible without replacing the
      ReAct loop from the previous page.

執行框架可以圍繞一次模型呼叫、一個確定性步驟、一個專家迴圈或一組並行分支界定工作流程範圍。在每個邊界處，執行框架都會決定哪些上下文可以跨越邊界、哪些部分可以分支，以及哪些結果將傳入工作流程的下一階段。扇出和固定路由讓這種控制清晰可見，同時保留上一頁介紹的
      ReAct 迴圈。

text.bbca6d86a57e.source:
The ReWOO pipeline was parallel by construction, since every query it planned ran
    concurrently against the glossary. A more common parallel pattern fans one shared
    input out to several specialists that each carry their own system prompt and all run
    at once. In the trace, total wall time tracks the slowest specialist while the others
    overlap inside that window, the Gantt chart shows each specialist's duration, and all
    specialists share one web-search result so cost stays bounded.
text.bbca6d86a57e.value: ReWOO 工作流程在設計上就是並行的，因為它規劃的每個查詢都會針對術語表併發執行。另一種更常見的並行模式是將一個共享輸入分發給多個專用代理程式；每個代理程式都有自己的系統提示詞，並且全部同時執行。在執行軌跡中，總耗時取決於最慢的專用代理程式，其他代理程式則在這段時間內重疊執行。甘特圖會顯示每個專用代理程式的執行時間，並且所有代理程式共享一項網路搜尋結果，從而將成本控制在一定範圍內。
